label: Two-way giving profile: y gives x being at w and withholds it at an accessible world where y exists
definition: TwoWayGiverAt F w y: y exists at w, and for some x and some world v accessible from w where y also exists, y gives x being at w (GivesTo, DEF 62dfa893-b633-4513-9790-8f9a0a3087e0) and does not give x being at v. An extensional exercise profile across worlds: giving x being and not giving it are both realized at worlds where the holder exists.
note: Analyst definition, attribution deferred. Intended reading: an act-or-refrain profile. Met. Theta 5, 1048a (read 2026-11-23, Ross translation, http://classics.mit.edu/Aristotle/metaphysics.9.ix.html): for non-rational potencies, when agent and patient meet, 'the one must act', 'but with the former kind of potency [the rational] this is not necessary'; what decides is 'desire or will', which is NOT typed here: the profile is satisfied alike by choice, by chance and by a varying external condition. Theta 2, 1046b, a rational power 'alike capable of contrary effects', is an analogy only: there both contraries are produced by exercise ('the scientific man produces both the contrary effects'), whereas withholding is non-exercise (ST I q.104 a.3 ad 3: annihilation 'would not imply an action'). Whether a power for an absence and this giving are one Theta 2-type potency is untyped: no type represents one potency with two sides (docs/notes/pruss-power-premises.md, gap 5). Example: on the Thomist account, God giving a creature being and being 'free not to continue their existence' (ST I q.104 a.3 co., read 2026-11-23, https://www.newadvent.org/summa/1104.htm; navigation, no claim). Non-examples: a fixed giver (DEF 7bc1d667-fda2-4744-b055-9ba6cbe7f648); a being that gives something new at v without withholding anything given at w (that is varying giving, DEF bd4c434d-be19-43ca-936b-f33eb6c15a8c, not this form). Implies GivingVariesAt.
